svg.text: Step 3 — Verify Ground and Power, then test readings
- Confirm all GND connections are common between Pi, ADS1115 and sensor.
- Power the Pi (and sensor VCC if separate) and run a simple script to read A0 values at low sample rate.
- Use the demo page (`/demo`) to validate UI and highlights before applying mains or higher voltages.
Safety check: use an isolation transformer or known low-voltage source when first testing to avoid damage or injury.
